title: Law to ban the fastest class of e-bikes
summary: This bill would prohibit operating class 3 e-bicycles, the fastest legal category capable of reaching 25 mph without pedaling, on city streets, in parks and in other public places. Violators would get warnings only until April 1, 2029, after which fines would rise from $0 for a first violation to $50 for a second and $100 for later violations within two years, with possible impoundment for unsafe repeat violations. The law would take effect 24 months after passage.
